title: How to Use It
intro: The brown board never moves. The white strip slides, and everything you read follows from where it stops.
steps: Drag the white strip sideways. It snaps so that each note lands exactly under one mode column.
The note under Ionian is the tonic. If it reads C, you are looking at C major and all seven columns are modes of C major.
Read down any column to get the chord built on that note: its triad, then its seventh chord.
Tap any note on the strip to send it straight to the Ionian column.
Slide one column to the right to add a sharp to the key, one to the left to add a flat.
Use Share to copy a link that reopens the exact position you are looking at.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.arrows: Left and right arrows move one column.
keyboard.pages: Page Up and Page Down jump a whole block of seven.
keyboard.homeEnd: Home and End go to the far ends of the strip.
